raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  python_min: 3.10
  name: revel
  version: 0.9.2.post1

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/revel-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2ad9763aadb71abac80153ea8c7463f425b69f3b9517171825d6e37a4368ca48

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - blessed >=1.20.0
    - readchar >=4.1.0
    - colorama >=0.4.6
    - typing-extensions >=4.12.2

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - revel
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  summary: Effortlessly spice up your terminal apps using colors, progressbars & more
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://gitlab.com/mad-moo/revel

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - thewchan
